observations.confidence: high for the selected success-handler calls; incomplete for the full authorization policy
observations.conclusion: LocalAuthenticationManager success paths invoke externalizedContext and bridge the result to Data/continuations.

observations.confidence: high: exact argument constants, selectors and indexed description strings are corroborated
observations.conclusion: Pairing request uses authentication type 5 (MacUnlockPhonePairing); ordinary authentication uses type 6 (MacUnlockPhone). Authorization data and IDS device ID are set in SFAuthenticationOptions. Authentication values are not control-protocol version numbers.
limits: This is the Mac-local request API, not the peer message layout.

observations.status: answered for the selected local dispatch
observations.confidence: high: method bodies, selector targets and Mach-service constant agree
observations.conclusion: Sharing connects to com.apple.sharingd.nsxpc and forwards requestEnablementUsingClientProxy and authenticateUsingClientProxy through an unlock-manager XPC proxy.

observations.status: answered for the selected Mac-local gate
observations.confidence: high: current-connection query and entitlement constant corroborated in code
observations.conclusion: SDUnlockXPCSession checks com.apple.private.sharing.unlock-manager on the current Mac XPC connection before forwarding requests to SDAuthenticationManager.
limits: A Mac-local entitlement gate does not establish iPhone-side platform checks.

observations.confidence: high for key-selection/session-construction calls; incomplete for current-flow reachability and policy
observations.conclusion: Pairing and authorization constructors select a local or local-attested long-term key and look up a remote key by device ID. Selected authorization branches pass an external ACM context to session construction.
limits: Precise current enrollment attestation/certificate policy remains unresolved.

observations.confidence: high for selected resolved helper/import calls; incomplete for a full peer protocol
observations.conclusion: Authorization setup reaches aks_remote_session; selected token/step methods reach aks_remote_session_token and aks_remote_session_step through native helpers.
limits: Complete type-6-to-flow route and operation ordering not established.
Crypto internals, transcript and peer verifier are not recovered.

observations.confidence: moderate: selected metadata names/fields are useful seeds, while formatting/offset defects limit interpretation
observations.conclusion: Production MacUnlockPhone flow metadata contains AKS managers and request/response/token/confirmation contexts, including an authorization-token input.
limits: Metadata does not establish operation execution or wire fields.
Corrupt or suspicious ivar offsets are excluded.

observations.confidence: unknown for acceptance: no fresh software-host enrollment or iPhone verifier test exists
observations.conclusion: Local authorization/service/key boundaries are mapped more precisely. Windows acceptance still requires independently reproducible enrollment and a compatible key/attestation exchange.
limits: No current iPhone-side attestation/long-term-key policy recovered.
